Things You Don‘t Know on Instagram: "Artemis II Commander Reid Wiseman says he "broke down in tears" when he saw a cross on a Navy chaplain's collar after returning from the moon. "I'm not really a religious person," he said. "But there was just no other avenue."

After returning from the farthest journey any human has ever taken — a 10-day mission around the moon — Artemis II Commander Reid Wiseman asked to see the Navy chaplain aboard the ship that recovered them from the Pacific Ocean. "I'm not really a religious person," he said at a NASA press conference on April 16, 2026. "But there was just no other avenue for me to explain anything or to experience anything." When the chaplain walked in, Wiseman broke down. "I saw the cross on his collar, and I just broke down in tears. It's very hard to fully grasp what we just went through." The crew saw the far side of the moon and witnessed a solar eclipse from behind it — firsts in human history."
